title: A dynamic image featuring a giant anthro
prompt:
A dynamic image featuring a giant anthropomorphic cat based on the attached reference character and the attached reference character posing together.

- The reference character is positioned in the lower-left corner of the frame, while the giant cat stands behind them at an overwhelming scale, dominating the composition.

- The reference character is wearing a short-sleeved T-shirt, trendy orange shorts, black-and-white sneakers, and silver wireless headphones. They are leaning slightly backward with their legs apart, striking a confident, stylish pose: the right hand points diagonally toward the upper-left, while the left index finger points directly toward the viewer. A subtle smile with a confident expression.

- The giant cat is an anthropomorphic, bipedal version of the attached reference character's cat, significantly larger than the character. It has rich, soft, ultra-detailed fur, heterochromia eyes (one blue and one orange) with vertical slit pupils, a pink nose, and long whiskers. Around its neck is a thick gold chain with a crescent moon pendant. It spreads both arms wide in a dynamic pose, with the left arm raised high and the right arm extended outward. Its tail curves slightly, and it wears a calm yet slightly cocky expression.

- The reference character stands in front of the giant cat's lower body, appearing much smaller in comparison. Both characters are posed as if performing or dancing together, creating a unified and energetic composition.

- Clean white background with only soft shadows beneath the characters, keeping the focus entirely on them.

- Watercolor-style background, while both the reference character and the giant cat are rendered in ultra-realistic style.

- Add a "MioNyang" watermark with a paw print in the bottom-right corner.

- Cinematic lighting, warm color temperature, soft yet crisp details, subtle floating light particles in the air, hyper-realistic textures, masterpiece, best quality, ultra-detailed, 8K.

Negative Prompt:
Low quality, blurry, noise, distorted face, asymmetrical eyes, cross-eyed, blurry pupils, incorrect fingers, extra fingers, deformed hands, deformed arms, overexposed, oversaturated colors, cropped face, cropped hands, blurry background, text, unwanted watermark, logo, signature, low resolution, JPEG artifacts, anatomy errors, deformed body, duplicate accessories, ugly, bad hands, bad fingers, extra limbs, mutation, out of focus.
